question: What additional composite forms are addressed to the beautiful-faced goddess?
premises: An eight-spoked lotus-petaled form is named
inference: The teaching adds further composite forms in direct address to the goddess.
uncertainties: The exact referent of ṣoḍaśaikaṃ is context-dependent
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, it is also eight-spoked with lotus petals, and sixteen-and-one.
